audit.title: Operation log
audit.intro: Shows the last 7 days by default, up to 31 days per search. Times use your local timezone. Records follow your current audit access scope.
audit.redacted: Some historical fields could not be safely interpreted and were omitted. The original record is retained.
audit.timeError: Enter both times. The end must follow the start, within 31 days.

configuration.intro: Manage global configuration. Authorization and department scope changes revoke affected sessions.
configuration.codeHelp: 2–64 letters, digits or underscores; start with a letter
configuration.name: Name
configuration.changeHelp: Codes and permission identifiers are immutable. Disabling retains references. You must sign in again if your authorization changes.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Manage employee IDs, departments and roles. Disabled accounts retain their history. Permission changes require a new sign-in.
users.roleHelp: Roles define permissions and department scope. The server checks your authority again when saving.
users.resetHelp: Resetting revokes existing sessions. The user must change this password at the next sign-in.
users.selfUpdateHelp: Updating your own account signs you out. Keep the management permissions you need.
users.disableConfirm: Disable this account and revoke its sessions?

loginFootnote: On your first sign-in, set a password of your own.
profileIntro: Manage your profile, language and account security.
languageHelp: Your selection will be used on your next sign-in.
securityHelp: Update your password to protect your work account.
forcedIntro: You are using an initial password. Set a new password, then sign in again.
passwordPolicy: 8–64 characters, including at least one English letter and one number.
passwordChanged: Password updated. Please sign in again.
unavailableText: Please try again later. The operation has not been confirmed as successful.

export.title: Export task
export.help: Exports the applied search, up to 10,000 rows and 16 MiB. CSV is for data exchange; import ID columns as text in spreadsheets. Progress does not mean business changes are committed.
export.newConfirm: Create a new export intent? The previous task is retained. Check its result first if the response was uncertain.
export.unknown: Submission result is unconfirmed. Check the original operation; retries must keep the same operation ID and filters.

factories.title: Factories
factories.desc: Synchronize K3 organizations or create factories manually. Production organizations are explicitly linked by stable identity; names are for display.
factories.name: Name
factories.nameHint: After manual creation, link a verified K3 organization. Matching names do not establish a mapping.

orders.title: Production order snapshot
orders.desc: From Kingdee production orders (planned / plan-confirmed only), stored per material line. Left: totals per order; right: material lines. Orders without a customer are hidden.
orders.syncing: Synchronizing production orders from K3. The list will update when synchronization completes.
orders.syncedRemoved: Order {{bill}} is no longer planned; removed from the snapshot
orders.excluded: {{n}} more orders without customer are hidden
orders.unmapped: These production orgs are not set up as factories; their orders cannot be generated: {{orgs}}
orders.search: Search order / PI / PO / material / customer
orders.pick: Pick an order on the left

rules.title: SN rules
rules.desc: Priority: per PI > per customer > general. Changing prefix, suffix, base, length or charset edits the version in place if unused, otherwise creates a new version; renaming never versions. New versions only affect SNs generated afterwards.
rules.name: Name
rules.charsetHint: Blank = default charset for the base; a custom one must match the base length without repeats.
rules.editUsed: The current version has been used: changing encoding creates a new version; issued SNs keep the old one.
rules.editUnused: The current version is unused and can be edited in place.

snPages.candidatesFailed: Could not load choices. Please retry.
snPages.mapHint: Select a verified K3 production organization. An existing mapping cannot be reassigned.
snPages.syncUnknown: Check sync history before retrying. An interrupted request does not cancel synchronization.
snPages.organizationSyncFailed: Orders were synchronized, but organization synchronization failed. Check unmapped organizations.
snPages.generationPending: SN generation is not available yet. Orders and historical quotas reflect the current snapshot.
snPages.factoryAssignmentHelp: Explicit bindings apply to restricted factory roles. An empty selection grants no factory access.

piInit.title: Start number & history import
piInit.desc: Go-live import: each PI may set a start number once before its first generation and optionally import SNs issued earlier (status printed, included in duplicate checks). Afterwards the start number is locked.
piInit.noRule: No rule (imported SNs cannot be decoded)
piInit.locked: This PI already has a start number or generated SNs (start: {{start}}).
piInit.startHint: Generation continues from max(start − 1, max imported serial) + 1 without gaps.
piInit.snPlaceholder: One full SN per line, or upload CSV / TXT (first column)
piInit.confirm: PI {{pi}}: start {{start}}, import {{n}} SNs. The start number cannot be changed afterwards. Continue?

generate.title: Generate & allocate
generate.desc: Per production order: preview and generate within the quota (pool status: to allocate), then allocate the whole order to its production org. Orders of the same factory and PI share one serial sequence.
generate.step2: Step 2: allocate to the production org
generate.limitHint: The page suggests 10000 items by default and can be adjusted. Source quota, encoding capacity and server resource admission are checked separately.
generate.startPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the suggested start
generate.startHint: Can be set only once per PI, before its first generation.
generate.startInvalid: Start number must be a positive integer
generate.needPreview: Generation requires a preview of the current inputs; change the quantity or start number and you must preview again.
generate.failed: Generation failed and was rolled back: {{msg}}
generate.allocHint: Allocate all {{pending}} currently pending items for this source order. Partial quantities are not supported.
generate.allocFactoryHint: Only the order's production org; all materials of the order go together.
generate.allocConfirm: Allocate {{qty}} SNs to {{factory}}? They become to-acquire.

schedule.title: Scheduled full sync
schedule.policy: Each run checks the current sync permissions of the person who saved these settings. Changed settings cancel in-flight publication. Interval: 10 minutes to 7 days.
schedule.workerStopped: The scheduler is stopped on this instance. Settings are saved, but this instance will not run them automatically.

snAcquire.title: Acquire / Print
snAcquire.desc: View SN quantities by factory and PI: ready to acquire, ready to print and applying.
snAcquire.rule: Acquire and print cover the whole factory + PI. Material filters affect the table below only.
snAcquire.emptyPis: No PI is ready to acquire or print
snAcquire.takeConfirm: Acquire all pending SNs for {{factory}} / {{pi}} (currently {{n}})? Ineligible items will have individual reasons.
snAcquire.printConfirm: Confirm all SNs ready to print for {{factory}} / {{pi}} (currently {{n}}) as printed and create fixed files?
snAcquire.queryReadOnly: Query access: view batches and authorized historical print files.
snAcquire.fixedBatch: These members were fixed at acquisition. Current status is separate; transfers or reacquisition do not rewrite history.
snAcquire.fixedPrint: Historical files retain the original print content. Downloading or recovering a file does not change SNs. Check current ownership and status before using labels.
snAcquire.printCommitted: Printing is confirmed. File: {{state}}. No further print confirmation is needed.

outcomes.STATE_CHANGED: State does not allow this action

snTransfer.title: Factory transfer
snTransfer.desc: SNs that are to-acquire, to-print or printed can move; the source is limited to one PI. A factory request puts SNs into pending; HQ approval moves them to the target (to-acquire there); rejection or withdrawal restores them. Any duplicate full SN in the target PI rejects the whole transfer.
snTransfer.rule: SNs to allocate or pending transfer cannot move; one open request per SN.
snTransfer.applyConfirm: The {{n}} SNs become pending until HQ decides. Target: {{factory}} · {{pi}}. Continue?
snTransfer.approveConfirm: Approve {{no}} ({{n}} SNs)? They move to the target as to-acquire.
snTransfer.rejectConfirm: Reject {{no}} ({{n}} SNs)? They return to their previous status.
snTransfer.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw {{no}}? SNs return to their previous status.
snTransfer.labels: Handle old physical labels at the site: recover, invalidate or relabel them. Historical print files remain available and do not prove current label validity.
snTransfer.fixed: Members and original states are fixed at transfer time. Current location is shown separately; later transfers do not rewrite history.
snTransfer.impact: Rule {{rule}}: target next start {{before}} → {{after}}; {{unused}} intermediate numbers will remain unused.
snTransfer.impactRestricted: Your permissions do not include the target PI’s full-factory start calculation.
snTransfer.impactNone: No cross-PI start impact is currently available.
snTransfer.impactNote: Calculated from current rules and inventory. An unbound PI may select another rule. Transfer does not advance the watermark; generation validates the final state.

snQuery.title: SN Query
snQuery.desc: Filter by factory, customer, PI, material, status, exact SN, source order or current acquisition batch.
snQuery.exportConfirm: Create a fixed snapshot of all matching items and generate a file?
snQuery.fixed: Files use the complete snapshot taken at submission. Later transfers, renames and downloads do not change it.
snQuery.snapshotCommitted: Query snapshot is fixed. File: {{state}}. Recovery does not query current SNs again.

snDashboard.title: Dashboard
snDashboard.pending: {{n}} pending transfers in the current scope

snAudit.title: Audit trail
snAudit.retention: Kept for {days} days; expired months are archived.
snAudit.intro: Historical people, factories, quantities and states. Defaults to the last 30 days in Shanghai time; archives use the same permissions.
snAudit.exportLimit: Up to {{n}} records per export. CSV escapes formula-like free text such as names; use XLSX for exact text cells.
snAudit.invalidDates: Start date must not follow end date.
